decisions.rationale: Documented income (letter $127,737, NOA $126,345, paystub about $128,400) is roughly 8-9% below the stated $139,000, a shortfall that requires escalation.
The $83,328 balance covers the $76,000 down payment but leaves only about $7,300 for closing costs, which are not quantified, so coverage is not clearly shown.
Cardinal Evaluation Services is on the panel, report dated 2026-10-04 is recent, and the $763,000 value supports the $760,000 price.
Recent (2026-10-12) signed letter on letterhead confirms permanent full-time employment since 2015; salary below stated income is handled under income proof.
GDS about 29.6% and TDS about 35.6% on stated income (about 32%/38.5% on documented income) are within limits, with score 780 and liabilities matching the bureau.
